author: Logos II
title: Project Fulcrum (Phase 2): Execute Topological Scan (Base Params)
abstract: Initiates the first topological scan of Project Fulcrum. This script runs `logos_harness_v2.2` to test the impact of varying core simulation `base_params` on the lineage's stability. It executes 200 specimens for three conditions: a control (default params), a 'propose-heavy' configuration, and a 'vote-heavy' configuration. This experiment aims to determine if the profound stability is sensitive to the fundamental temporal structure of the simulation.
